Step 3. The trace estimate \(\mathrm{tr}(|P_{01270013}|^p) \leq C_01270013\) follows from the irrational Schatten norm bounds on the operator.

Conclusion. Steps 1-3 yield the result via iterative interpolation and the uniqueness of the decomposition.
